candidate_redesign_directions.name: instance_level_affordance_variation
candidate_redesign_directions.description: Objects within same category vary in affordance profiles. Visible features partially indicate affordance. Probing confirms.
candidate_redesign_directions.example: Some apples are ripe (edible), some are unripe (inedible). Visible color partially indicates ripeness.

candidate_redesign_directions.name: hidden_subtypes_within_categories
candidate_redesign_directions.description: Each category contains hidden subtypes with different affordance profiles. Visible features shared within category.
candidate_redesign_directions.example: Wood_log subtype A crafts planks well but burns poorly. Subtype B burns well but crafts poorly.

candidate_redesign_directions.name: query_suite_expansion
candidate_redesign_directions.description: Add query templates requiring positive evidence, negative evidence, and positive+negative conjunctions.

candidate_redesign_directions.name: observation_noise_or_partial_observability
candidate_redesign_directions.description: Observation gives useful features but not full affordance-relevant feature set. Some features only revealed by probing.

candidate_redesign_directions.name: balanced_query_construction
candidate_redesign_directions.description: Ensure each query has both positive and negative examples. Evaluated primarily with macro_query_balanced_accuracy.

dominance_rule.condition: macro_bal_A >= macro_bal_B AND normalized_cost_A <= normalized_cost_B AND at_least_one_strict

meaningful_improvement_over_c0b.statistical: macro_bal gain > 2 standard errors across seeds
meaningful_improvement_over_c0b.cost: outperform random_probe_budgeted or proportional oracle-mixing at comparable cost

1J1.description: Implement one minimal redesigned environment candidate.

1J2.description: Run marginal-value audit on redesigned environment.

1J3.description: If 1J2 passes: run C0b/C13/random_probe/oracle policy comparison under Pareto reporting.

1J4.description: Multi-seed sweep (5 seeds x N policies).
